body:
`resource_uid.h` goes from being included in 2527 files to 47, so a 98.1% reduction... not bad. 
It is also only replaced in 826 includers by `resource_uid_types.h`, which is a significantly cheaper include (since it doesn't include anything). This is a replacement rate of 32.6%.

Calculating the total reduction in transitively included headers for the 2480 that no longer include `resource_uid.h` is not a current capacity of my software (I could add that if you want?).
I don't think we need to, though. The 98.1% reduction (with only a 32.6% replacement rate) alone is, in my opinion, worth doing, even if it doesn't result in much secondary reduction. Still cleans up the codebase and transitive paths. 
* Edit: `resource_uid.h` was also 20th on the recompile cost list, so that alone makes it a worthy target.

This change alone may not get us there, but we need to cut all the heads of the hydra if we want to solve the problem. 

Looks like there are a handful of paths that still generate a ton of transitive includes for `resource_uid_types.h`, hopefully those can be addressed.

> Calculating the total reduction in transitively included headers for the 2480 that no longer include `resource_uid.h` is not a current capacity of my software (I could add that if you want?).

That could be useful IMO to assess how impactful the changes we do are, but that may partially overlap with what @Ivorforce's tool does. If you think it can be implemented easily feel free to take a jab at it, but if that's complex it's maybe not a priority. Also not sure how best to visualize it in the reports.

So the way I added it is that it can now sum the unique includes for each includer for any given file. This works in this scenario since there was only one gateway, `resource.h`, so running that function on that gateway before and after allows us to compare. 

Before: 165877
After: 165123
0.4% reduction

(Numbers edited to reflect true include cost by only counting unique includes for `*.cpp` includers)

> but it's still significantly bigger than resource.h itself (GDVIRTUAL, RefCounted, SelfList).

I need to correct you on this, through `ref_counted.h`, it includes many more things. In fact, this PR does not change the total number of files included by `resource.h`, which remains 78. This means that it includes everything that `resource_uid.h` includes through other paths. 

**However,** that doesn't mean the change isn't worth doing. Still cutting one of the hydra's heads. Whether or not we will be able to cut the rest is something we'd need to evaluate, but I do not believe is a requirement for the approval of this PR. 

Looking at the report for what `resource.h` includes after this PR, a lot of paths through `resource_uid.h` are gone, although in all cases, a path through (most of the time) `gdvirtual.gen.h` remains. All that means is that that should be our next target.

My approval still stands; this change is just stylistic.
For now I don't feel the churn added by this PR is worth the gain, so I don't plan to revisit it in the near future.
